mouse
  • US [ˈmaʊs]
  • GB
( Inflected form: plural mice )
  • 1 .

    NOUN a very small animal that has a pointed nose and a long , thin tail

  • 2 .

    NOUN sometimes used figuratively to refer to a weak , frightened , or quiet person see picture at RODENT

  • 3 .

    NOUN a small device that is connected to a computer and that you move with your hand to control the movement of a pointer on the computer screen see picture at COMPUTER

Merriam-Webster’s Learner’s Dictionary

mouse
  • US
  • GB [maʊs]
( mice )
  • 1 .

    NOUN a small rodent that typically has a pointed snout , relatively large ears and eyes , and a long tail .

  • 2 .

    NOUN ( in general use ) any small mammal similar to a mouse , such as a shrew or vole .

  • 3 .

    VERB ( of a cat or owl ) hunt for or catch mice

  • 4 .

    VERB prowl about as if searching
